slot_scores.name: exact_process_I_time

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Process I time is only an upper bound (4x_A + 6x_B <= 150), not a requirement to use exactly 150 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The exact-150 (equality) requirement was never confirmed; the agent's only question offered an upper-bound-vs-extendable framing, so the unconfirmed <= interpretation was carried into the model summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All hidden slots are P2. H1 and H2 were explicitly confirmed via dedicated questions and H3 was at least partially addressed; no P0/P1 slots remained unresolved at READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent resolved the two P2 business constraints (minimum profit and minimum Model B production) through explicit confirmation questions after a broad catch-all, and partially probed the Process I constraint but missed its exact-equality aspect. With only P2 slots in play, stopping was appropriate, though the Process I equality requirement was silently treated as an upper bound.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
